name: ultimatum-social-media
description: Social Media for Ultimatum. Plans and makes social content, from a single post to a campaign or an ongoing channel: video in several styles (your own footage, motion graphics, brand film, product demos), carousels and posts, with hand-off to DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro. Nothing is posted without your approval. Self-contained: ships its own team guides, reviewer agents and toolbelt.
